title: Frog Relay Hops
description:
## Task

A frog crosses a row of stepping stones numbered from 0. From stone `i` it may hop forward any distance from 1 up to `reach[i]` stones. It starts on stone 0 and wants to land on the last stone. Return the fewest hops needed, or -1 if the last stone cannot be reached.

## Input

- `reach` — a list of non-negative integers, the longest hop allowed from each stone. It has at least one stone.

## Output

The fewest hops (an integer): 0 if the frog already stands on the last stone; -1 if it cannot get there.

## Example

```python
fewest_hops([2, 3, 1, 1, 4])  # returns 2
fewest_hops([3, 2, 1, 0, 4])  # returns -1
fewest_hops([0])  # returns 0
```

## Constraints

- 1 ≤ length of `reach` ≤ 10^5
- 0 ≤ each value ≤ 10^5
